primaryOutcome.name: future noncontact-or-indirect-contact ACL rupture
primaryOutcome.label: acl_tear_within_horizon
primaryOutcome.definition: Complete anterior cruciate ligament rupture occurring after the prediction index within the prespecified risk horizon, medically confirmed and classified as noncontact or indirect contact by the adjudication protocol.
excludeFromPrimaryTarget: suspected ACL injury without medical confirmation
injury occurring before or at the prediction index
primaryOutcome.reasonForScope: The initial model is intended to study modifiable intrinsic and movement-related susceptibility. Direct-contact trauma has a materially different causal mechanism and is not pooled into the primary biomechanical prediction target.

recommendedPredictionDesign.index: standardized ACL screening assessment or weekly athlete checkpoint
recommendedPredictionDesign.mathematicalForm: P(ACL within horizon) = 1 - exp(-E * exp(beta0 + sum(beta_j*z_j)))
recommendedPredictionDesign.notes: The final beta coefficients and baseline scale must be estimated and calibrated from prospective ACL outcomes. Literature odds ratios may seed priors but cannot substitute for prospective fitting.

criticalPredictorDomains.measurement: standardized front/side landing or single-leg hop protocol with versioned MediaPipe-derived 2D measurements
criticalPredictorDomains.limitations: 2D video is not interchangeable with laboratory 3D kinematics or kinetics. Every camera feature requires task-specific measurement validation.

criticalPredictorDomains.measurement: dynamometry or another validated strength protocol
force plate or independently validated video-to-kinetics surrogate
training records, wearable/GPS when available, and prespecified self-report
clinical examination or imaging when available
criticalPredictorDomains.notes: Do not infer imaging/anatomic variables from ordinary webcam video.

measurementQualityPolicy: Capture-quality variables may reject or stratify measurements but must not become biological ACL-risk predictors unless a future protocol provides a defensible causal/measurement rationale.
minimumValidationRequirements: mechanism adjudication separating noncontact/indirect from direct contact
all model/feature/calibration decisions made within training folds
subgroup robustness by sex/sport/site when sample size permits
independent external validation before clinical probability display
